notes.title: Update
notes.content:
1. Fix bug when nothing happening after tutorial.
2. Add Turkish language.

notes.title: Gameplay Improvements
notes.content:
Hello! Patch with improvements for gameplay available now!

- Added more batteries to the world, so now you will no worries about drone charging.
- Fixed battery in homeless room, when drone could be damaged by the battery.
- Fixed low resolution clock texture on the timelapse cutscene.
- Separated cloud save folders for different stores.
- Removed wrong dummy item.

Your feedback is invaluable as we continue to refine and enhance the game. Thank you for your support!

notes.title: Strange House is now available!
notes.content:
Hello! 

We are happy to announce that our long-awaited game "Strange House" is now live! Open the doors to this captivating world of mysteries, eagerly awaiting its explorers.

We invite you to immerse yourself in this captivating story and share your impressions. Your feedback is important to us! Write reviews, share your discoveries and feelings so that we can make the game even more engaging and thrilling.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43520373/22ecef83866f02d7dbff41b3da4862ddfdbbf4f5.jpg[/img]

Best Regards!

notes.title: Release date and media update on the store page!
notes.content:
Hello!

Recently, the game acquired an official release date with publication on the Steam page and this is November 3, 2023. This release date was chosen related with the Early Access status, which has also already been published.

Additionally, we've updated the screenshoots on the store page and added a gameplay trailer.

We invite you to check out the trailer:

[previewyoutube=w8u7fdvrEIs;full][/previewyoutube]
We look forward to your comments to improve the game further!

Best Regards!
